Program Description and Provision of Services Agreement
Program Projections and Tracking Requirements
TitleIII-B Program enables older individuals to remain physical, mental and social active through
services designed to meet their needs.This program helps older adult individuals to remain in their own
homes by providing supportive services, to enhance their health and to be active contributors to their
families and communities.
Scope of Services
The TitleI-B Supportive Services program provide services to support and enable State and
community agencies serving older individuals,60andover, to:1.Access services to remain
independent living and continue tobe active members in their communities;2.Provide health education
and information to increase the quality of life of older Americans, especially for those who have the
greatest economic needs and those with limited English proficiency;3.Promote physical activities and
healthy lifestyle to prevent pre-mature institution aliz ation.
Eligibility for these services: Client must be60years of age or older, with particular attention to
serving economically and socially vulnerable older adults and rural residents.
